purpose: Reconcile Binance's public SAFU BTC wallet, its stated deployment timetable, Futures Insurance Fund reallocation, and the ADGM legal custodian.

sources.title: Security Incident Recovery Update #3 — SAFU and Futures Insurance Fund FAQ
claims: Binance states the aggregate covered amount reached 90%; BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC were fully backed 100% on a 2026-10-31 00:00 UTC PoR snapshot.
Binance says partial SAFU deployment is expected within the 24 hours after the update; the FAQ says part of SAFU is being used to acquire the remaining 10% of affected assets.

Binance says a portion of the Futures Insurance Fund was rebalanced to cover affected assets; the fund is not user assets, supports bankrupt-position deficits and reduces ADL, and the remaining balance is above the required minimum.
Binance says SAFU is held and managed by Nest Clearing and Custody Limited; a portion serves as regulatory capital reserves under ADGM obligations.
Binance identifies its public SAFU BTC wallet as 1BAuq7Vho2CEkVkUxbfU26LhwQjbCmWQkD and commits to replenishing SAFU toward approximately USD 1 billion.
Binance says full zero-knowledge PoR proof is estimated by November 3 and withdrawals are targeted to resume Sunday, November 1.
limitations: All recovery, coverage and fund deployment statements are company claims; the full ZK proof was not available at capture.
The 24-hour SAFU deployment window had not elapsed at the 16:45 UTC capture.
No XRP-specific replacement purchase quantity, SAFU draw amount, or futures-fund transfer amount is disclosed.

sources.title: Public Bitcoin address balance and transaction summary for Binance-designated SAFU wallet
claims: The address identified by Binance as its SAFU BTC wallet is displayed with a balance of 15,000.00147092 BTC.
BitInfoCharts lists 31,277.00006 BTC received across 28 incoming transactions, last received 2026-08-09 01:20:03 UTC; 16,276.9991 BTC sent across five outgoing transactions, last sent 2024-04-18.
At capture the displayed balance remained approximately 15,000 BTC; no post-April-18-2024 outgoing transaction appears in the provider's summary.
limitations: Single third-party explorer observation; the linked Blockchain.com page is dynamic and did not expose readable transaction rows in this capture.
The public address may not represent every asset or every legal/operational account of SAFU; no independent custody attestation was obtained.
The official 24-hour deployment window had not expired; absence of a visible transfer at capture does not prove no deployment elsewhere or off-chain.

sources.title: Hourly exchange futures insurance fund balances
claims: SwoleCharts reports Binance futures insurance funds totaling approximately USD 2.46B at 15:00 UTC on October 31, +0.14% over 24 hours and +0.62% over seven days; its October 2 reference was approximately USD 2.41B.
The page lists a Binance XRPUSDT isolated/shared pool with approximately USD 65.83M USDT covering ten symbols including XRP, ADA, BCH, DOT, ETC, LINK, LTC, TRX, XLM and XMR.
The page lists a Bybit XRPUSD isolated pool holding approximately 55.58M XRP, displayed near USD 69.33M.
limitations: Third-party aggregator, not Binance's official daily fund snapshot; methodology and completeness require validation.
Binance's XRPUSDT pool is shared across ten symbols and is not XRP-specific collateral.
Bybit's XRPUSD isolated pool is a separate venue and contract; do not combine it with Binance's pool.
A flat or rising aggregate total does not disprove a transfer from one pool; fees, asset prices, rebalancing and other pool flows can offset movements.

sources.title: FSRA Public Register: Nest Clearing and Custody Limited
claims: Nest Clearing and Custody Limited is listed as Active, Recognition Order Number 0070, date 8 December 2025, Type of Recognition Order Recognised Clearing House.
The register lists previous name Binance (AD) Limited and trading name Binance.
The register lists activities of Providing Custody and Operating a Central Securities Depository.
limitations: The register establishes this legal entity's ADGM recognition and activities; it does not independently attest the amount, segregation or availability of SAFU assets.

sources.title: Binance's ADGM Launch Update — three regulated legal entities
claims: Nest Exchange Limited is the Recognised Investment Exchange responsible for on-exchange spot and derivatives trading.
Nest Clearing and Custody Limited is the Recognised Clearing House responsible for clearing, settlement, central-counterparty functions and custody.
Nest Trading Limited is the Broker-Dealer responsible for off-exchange principal and agency services, including OTC and Convert.
limitations: This describes the ADGM legal structure; it does not establish that every Binance service or customer in every jurisdiction contracts with the same entity.

independence_policy: Binance's announcement is a company claim. ADGM's register independently confirms the legal entity's regulatory status, not SAFU balances. BitInfoCharts and SwoleCharts are separate third-party data providers; neither replaces the official daily fund snapshot or a custody attestation.
